title: Yellow agency post with a confident woman in glasses and cyan circles (AI-generated, garbled text)
whatItIs: A square mustard-yellow post with a smiling woman in round glasses, hoop earrings and a mustard turtleneck with arms crossed, cyan circles of various sizes, a blue headline and small label boxes; the copy is AI-generated and illegible ('vibrant acancy socialy socicial').
whatItMeans: Warm and confident; outfit matching the background makes the subject feel part of the brand — but the garbled text shows why AI mockups need real typesetting.
techniques: Match the model's outfit to the background colour.
Add a complementary colour through simple circles.
Pose the subject with crossed arms for confidence.
